mcqs.question:
With reference to the extension of the Jal Jeevan Mission, consider the following statements:
1. The Mission has been extended till December 2028.
2. During Phase I (2019–2024), expenditure was ₹8.69 lakh crore, while central assistance increased from ₹2.08 lakh crore to ₹3.59 lakh crore.
3. The Sujalam Bharat framework includes a unique ID for every village, the Sujal Gaav ID, annual Jal Utsav and the goal of providing FHTC to every rural household.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. The Jal Jeevan Mission was extended to December 2028; its Phase I expenditure and increase in central assistance were as stated, while Sujalam Bharat provides the village-identification and annual Jal Utsav framework aimed at FHTC for every rural household. The alternatives omit at least one of these correct aspects.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following statements about the Sujalam Bharat framework under the Jal Jeevan Mission is incorrect?
options: It provides a unique ID for each village.
The Sujal Gaav ID has been introduced in 31 States/UTs.
It includes an annual Jal Utsav.
Its goal is to provide FHTC for every urban household.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the goal is FHTC for every urban household. The stated goal is FHTC for every rural household; the framework also includes unique village IDs, Sujal Gaav ID in 31 States/UTs and an annual Jal Utsav.

mcqs.question: Where and when was the 22nd instalment of PM-KISAN released in March 2026?
options: ₹2,000 to about 9.32 crore farmers at Guwahati on 13 March 2026
₹6,000 to about 9.32 crore farmers at Ajmer on 13 March 2026
₹2,000 to about 9.32 crore farmers at Guwahati on 24 February 2019
₹2,000 to about 9.32 crore farmers at Bengaluru on 13 March 2026
mcqs.explanation: The 22nd PM-KISAN instalment of ₹2,000 was released to approximately 9.32 crore farmers at Guwahati on 13 March 2026. ₹6,000 is the annual support amount under the scheme, while Ajmer and 24 February 2019 belong to other contexts.

mcqs.question:
With reference to PM-KISAN, consider the following statements:
Statement A: PM-KISAN provides ₹2,000 per year in three instalments.
Statement B: The scheme was launched on 24 February 2019.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Statement A is false because PM-KISAN provides ₹6,000 per year in three instalments. Statement B is true: the scheme was launched on 24 February 2019.

mcqs.question: Under the nationwide HPV vaccination programme launched at Ajmer, which group is to receive free Gardasil?
options: Girls under 14, through PHCs and schools
All farmers through Agriculture Insurance Company offices
mcqs.explanation: Free Gardasil is provided to girls under 14 through primary health centres and schools. The programme is not meant for farmers, railway beneficiaries or TB patients.

mcqs.question:
With reference to tuberculosis, consider the following statements:
1. Mycobacterium tuberculosis is airborne and mainly affects the lungs, though it can affect other organs.
2. Without treatment, mortality is approximately 50%, while four to six months of treatment cures about 90% of cases.
3. The global target is 2030, India’s target is 2025, and the next UN High-Level Meeting is scheduled for 2028.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcqs.explanation: All three statements are correct. Tuberculosis is airborne, untreated disease has approximately 50% mortality, four to six months of treatment cures about 90%, and the stated global, Indian and UN meeting targets are 2030, 2025 and 2028 respectively. Each restricted option leaves out one correct statement.

mcqs.question:
How many of the following statements are correct regarding integration and screening under TB-related initiatives?
1. NTEP includes bidirectional TB–diabetes screening, and the Chennai cohort found 34% of TB patients to be diabetic, with 41% of them poorly controlled.
2. In the pilot, about 3,000 of 26,000 screened persons had COPD/asthma.
3. The Chennai cohort found 41% of TB patients to be diabetic, with 34% of them poorly controlled.
4. In the pilot, about 300 of 26,000 screened persons had COPD/asthma.
mcqs.explanation: Only statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Chennai figures were 34% diabetic and 41% of those poorly controlled, while the pilot identified about 3,000 cases among 26,000 screened; statements 3 and 4 reverse or change those details.

mcqs.question:
Match List-I with List-II regarding Indian TB initiatives.

List-I
 a. NTEP
 b. Nikshay Portal
 c. Nikshay Poshan Yojana
 d. PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan

List-II
 i. Digital patient tracking
 ii. Free diagnosis and treatment
 iii. ₹1,000/month nutrition support
 iv. Community participation and patient adoption

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-ii, b-i, c-iii and d-iv. NTEP provides free diagnosis and treatment; Nikshay tracks patients digitally; Nikshay Poshan Yojana provides ₹1,000/month nutrition support; and PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan stresses community participation and patient adoption.

mcqs.question: Which Indian TB initiative is associated with Universal Drug Susceptibility Testing?
mcqs.explanation: UDST is associated with Universal Drug Susceptibility Testing. Nikshay Portal concerns digital patient tracking, while NTEP and PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan have different stated features.

mcqs.question: Which initiative was launched by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj as a social media campaign against the practice of ‘Sarpanch Pati’?
mcqs.explanation: “Say No to Proxy Sarpanch” was the Ministry of Panchayati Raj campaign against the practice of ‘Sarpanch Pati’. The campaign ran from Women’s Day till March 18 and was associated with Minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh.

mcqs.question: The Krishi Sakhi Program of the Agriculture Insurance Company is linked to which development?
options: FAO’s declaration of 2026 as the International Year of Women Farmers
FAO’s declaration of 2026 as the International Year of Tribal Brands
The extension of Jal Jeevan Mission till 2028
mcqs.explanation: The Krishi Sakhi Program is associated with the Agriculture Insurance Company and the FAO declaration of 2026 as the International Year of Women Farmers. The other options refer to PM-KISAN, tribal branding or Jal Jeevan Mission.

mcqs.question:
Match the following with their associated details.

List-I
 a. Vote Sweetened Kerala
 b. Agriculture Insurance Company
 c. PMFBY
 d. FAO

List-II
 i. Established in 2002
 ii. Implemented from 2016
 iii. Halwa for first-time voters
 iv. Headquarters at Rome and Director-General Qu Dongyu

Select the correct code.
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are a-iii, b-i, c-ii and d-iv. Vote Sweetened Kerala used halwa for first-time voters under Article 326; the Agriculture Insurance Company was established in 2002, implements PMFBY from 2016, and FAO is headquartered in Rome with Qu Dongyu as Director-General.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the institutional framework of Rural Self Employment Training Institutes (RSETIs)?
options: They have operated since 2009–10 under the Ministry of Rural Development with banks, with NIRDPR as the associated institution.
They are based on the RUDSETI 1982 model but began only in 2019 under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
They have operated since 2009–10 under Indian Railways, with NIMHANS as the associated institution.
They were established in 1982 under the Ministry of Rural Development without bank involvement.
mcqs.explanation: RSETIs have operated since 2009–10 under the Ministry of Rural Development with banks, drawing on the RUDSETI 1982 model; NIRDPR is the associated institution. The other options change the ministry, institution, start period or role of banks.
